\begingroup\footnotesize\noindent\textbf{Notes to Table~\ref{tab:hashes}.} What each one fixed: 
\emph{BNM $\times$ nb3 budget} --- budget 1000, outcome \texttt{no\_matched\_arm\_budget}: the arm's own-objective reading only, never cross-arm comparable. The file carries no timestamp and no before-flag, so its timing rests on the project record alone.
\emph{BNM $\times$ nb3 pre-registration} --- $\gamma$ from a metric-blind rule; budget left OPEN because the budget rule reads a crossing only the development run produces.
\emph{CORAL $\times$ nb3 budget} --- budget 2000, declared on cost and explicitly not the argmax.
\emph{DANN $\times$ nb3 budget + sensitivity readout} --- budget 4000 = 2 $\times$ the $\lambda$ horizon, and the step-2000 sensitivity pre-declaration: the headline is the mean at 4000, and the mean at step 2000 is a budget-sensitivity check that \emph{does not replace it, whichever is higher} (key \texttt{PRE\_DECLARED\_headline\_and\_sensitivity}). Every confirmatory fold records this file's self-certifying digest when it starts, so this rule is verified as fixed before the folds.
\emph{DANN $\times$ nb3 pre-registration} --- arms, abort conditions, the rule for declaring the margin M, the budget decision, the headline/sensitivity rule, and the predictions, including \texttt{prediction\_arc\_suppression} and \texttt{3\_spread\_not\_mean}. The date and the \emph{before} are those of a pre-fold copy of this file (history entry \dannPrefoldEntry{}, archived as \texttt{evidence/prefold/dann\_r5\_prereg\_kaggle\_v2\_20260902.json}); the file itself was regenerated after the folds, on 2026-09-05, which added \dannPrefoldAddedKeys{} post-fold keys and left all \dannPrefoldIdenticalKeys{} pre-fold keys identical. The copy does \emph{not} establish the arc-suppression prediction's precedence over its own fold-0 test, whose outcome it already contains (history entry \dannArcEntry{} was not recovered).
\emph{$\lambda=0$ control pre-registration} --- budget 4000 under the rule \emph{the control is read where its treatment is read}; both decision branches, and the four pre-registered paired contrasts.
\emph{Checkpoint-window averaging declaration} --- $k=8$ primary, the grid $\{1,2,4,8\}$, both score combinations, and the window placed by the pre-registered read-off so the rule reads no metric; it governs analyses, not training runs.
\emph{BNM step-0 gradient norms, re-measured} --- a second, later measurement; the $\gamma$ grid is never re-derived from it and its original measuring run is lost. Protected, but not a pre-registration: it governs no run.
A further digest in the project record, \texttt{7356acda\ldots}, is the hash of a \emph{superseded} pre-registration text, kept deliberately and correctly matching no live file. \textbf{The one row marked \emph{no} above is hashed in the record but absent from \texttt{runs/protected\_artifacts.json}}, the inventory \texttt{verify()} walks, so it receives neither the re-check nor the read-only protection the other seven do. It is reported here rather than quietly enrolled, because enrolling it now would date its protection to the paper rather than to the declaration.\par\endgroup
